title: Organization overview: Improved AVP dashboard experience (Active Users)
description:
Organization admins can now experience a more informative and accessible active users insights dashboard on the Overview page of Atlassian Administration. We've improved the dashboard with app filtering options, more informative tooltips, and enhanced accessibility to help you monitor your organization's activity more effectively. To get started with this change Go to admin.atlassian.com.
	Select your organization if you have more than one.
